remarks: Center of downtown Stamford - secure building with spacious lobby and two elevators. Intercom from lobby to unit. One bedroom updated corner unit in rear of building with screened balcony. Lots of windows, new window blinds! Euro style kitchen and bath. Heat, hot water and gas included. Light and bright laundry room on lobby level. First month rent and two months security. $100.00 move in and $100.00 move out. No more than 2 occupants allowed - condo rules. No car needed. Close to stores, restaurants, library, mall and UCONN. Minimum credit score 700. Moves can only be Monday thru Friday and must be scheduled with super in advance. NO DOGS but one cat may be allowed. NO SMOKING ON PREMISES. PLEASE NOTE: there is no on site parking. Tenants can park on street or in Bedford Parking garage or rent a space from church. Monthly permit is approximately $75- 100. per month for residents.
